items.rule: color-code (Void space background: dusty magenta, low saturation)
items.reason: The brightest cores (centre around x 600 y 420, left around x 250 y 720, bottom around x 850 y 1060) turn rosy pink-salmon and noticeably more saturated than the rest of the image, so they leave the dusty, low-saturation magenta family (peak #954B81 is also above the brief's #8A4A84) and start to compete with the floor's brightness tier.
items.correction: Keep this exact image, same strands, gaps and layout; only desaturate and darken the brightest magenta cores to dusty magenta no brighter than #7E3C78, with no pink or salmon tint.
